subject.text: Your package is on hold, shipping fee short by Rp 5.000

body.text: Your package is being held at our warehouse because the shipping fee is Rp 5.000 short.
Pay within 24 hours or the package will be returned to the sender.

explanation: The sender domain kirimcepat-id.test does not belong to KirimCepat (kirimcepat.test), and the link goes to a different site that asks for payment. The small amount and the deadline are there to make you pay quickly without getting suspicious.
hints: Compare the sender's address with KirimCepat's official domain, kirimcepat.test.
Press and hold the "Pay now" link. Who owns that domain?
